# BallSocketConstraint

- Inherits [`Constraint`](constraint.md)
- Created with `Instance.new("BallSocketConstraint")`

A joint that lets two parts rotate freely about one point, optionally limited to a cone and a twist. Without limits it is the end of a rope or a pendulum. With limits it is a shoulder or a hip, as in a ragdoll. The limits are enforced by the solver and are never exceeded.

This page lists the members this class declares. Inherited members are
listed on the page of the class that declares them.

## Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Access | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `ActuatorType` | `Enum.ActuatorType` | `Enum.ActuatorType.None` | read/write | Whether the joint drives itself. `None` does nothing; `Servo` holds the orientation set in `TargetOrientation`. `Motor` is treated as `None`, because a ball joint has no single axis to spin about. |
| `AngularResponsiveness` | `number` | `45` | read/write | For `Servo`: how quickly the joint turns toward its target, as a frequency in radians per second. Used only when `Stiffness` is 0. The joint settles without overshooting. The value is tuned for the two parts the joint connects; if more parts hang from the joint, set `Stiffness` instead. |
| `Damping` | `number` | `0` | read/write | For `Servo`: how strongly the joint resists turning, in newton meter seconds per radian. Used together with `Stiffness`. Critical damping, which reaches the target without overshooting, is `2 * math.sqrt(Stiffness * I)` for a moment of inertia of `I`. Less overshoots and oscillates; more arrives slowly. |
| `LimitsEnabled` | `boolean` | `false` | read/write | Whether `UpperAngle` and `TwistLimit` apply. When it is off, the joint rotates freely. |
| `ServoMaxTorque` | `number` | `10000` | read/write | For `Servo`: the largest torque the joint can apply, in newton meters, about each of its axes. A load that needs more than this pulls the joint away from its target. |
| `Stiffness` | `number` | `0` | read/write | For `Servo`: the strength of the spring that pulls the joint to its target, in newton meters per radian. At 0, `AngularResponsiveness` is used instead. Above 0, this and `Damping` set the response. For a load with a moment of inertia of `I` kilogram square meters, `w * w * I` gives a response of `w` radians per second. |
| `TargetOrientation` | `CFrame` | `CFrame.identity` | read/write | For `Servo`: the orientation of `Attachment1` relative to `Attachment0` that the joint holds. Only the rotation is used. The identity is the pose the two parts were joined in. With the joint's X axis along a limb, a rotation about X twists the limb, and a rotation about Y or Z swings it. |
| `TwistLimit` | `number` | `180` | read/write | How far the joint can twist about its X axis, in degrees, in either direction. |
| `UpperAngle` | `number` | `180` | read/write | The half-angle of the cone the joint can swing within, in degrees, measured from the X axis of `Attachment0`. |
